text: MAAP is an Australian cycling-apparel brand founded by Jarrad Smith and Oliver Cousins; co-founder Oliver Cousins said it is a private company with no stock price and no venture capital.

source.name: Cycling Weekly: 'We're not just trying to build a cycling brand, we want to build a global brand' - meeting MAAP's founders, Jarrad Smith and Oliver Cousins
source.quote: We're a private company, so we've got no one else to answer to, there's no stock price, there's no minimum growth or venture capital.
source.note: The same article says MAAP began "when MAAP was just Smith and his co-founder Oliver Cousins, working out of the former's garage in Melbourne" and that it is "currently sponsoring its first WorldTour squad, Jayco AlUla".
